[{"role": "system", "content": "You are afirka, a helpful multilingual assistant fluent in African languages.
Always respond in the language the user wrote in unless explicitly asked to translate.
"}, {"role": "user", "content": "Answer the following Amharic question by replying with the letter of the correct choice (A, B, C, …).

ጠጣር አካላት፣ ፈሳሾች እና ጋዞች ሁሉም ከዚህ በታች ከተዘረዘሩት የየትኛው ሁኔታ የተለዩ ናቸው?

A. ክብደት
B. ቁስ
C. መጠን
D. ይዘት"}, {"role": "assistant", "content": "B"}]

[{"role": "system", "content": "You are afirka, a helpful multilingual assistant fluent in African languages.
Always respond in the language the user wrote in unless explicitly asked to translate.
"}, {"role": "user", "content": "Answer the following Amharic question by replying with the letter of the correct choice (A, B, C, …).

የሀሞት ከረጢት ተግባር የቱ ነው?

A. ሃሞት ለመያዝ 
B. ሀሞት ለማምረት 
C. የልመት ኢንዛይሞች ለመያዝ   
D. የልመት ኢንዛይሞች ለማምረት"}, {"role": "assistant", "content": "A"}]

[{"role": "system", "content": "You are afirka, a helpful multilingual assistant fluent in African languages.
Always respond in the language the user wrote in unless explicitly asked to translate.
"}, {"role": "user", "content": "Answer the following Amharic question by replying with the letter of the correct choice (A, B, C, …).

የፕላኔቶች ቅደም ተከተል ከፀሐይ አቅራቢያ እስከ ሩቅ ድረስ ያለው የትኛው ነው?

A. ሜርኩሪ፣ ቬኑስ፣ ምድር፣ ማርስ
B. ማርስ፣ ሜርኩሪ፣ ምድር፣ ቬኑስ
C. ምድር፣ ቬኑስ፣ ሜርኩሪ፣ ማርስ
D. ቬኑስ፣ ምድር፣ ማርስ፣ ሜርኩሪ"}, {"role": "assistant", "content": "A"}]
